name: OpenCLIP ViT-B/32
description: Visual concepts and text search over scene frames (beach, food, city, people …).
license: MIT (open_clip; LAION model card: English-only, research-oriented, fixed tag taxonomy used)
notes: Image encoder as OpenVINO IR (FP16 weights, unchanged since v1) + precomputed text embeddings for a fixed bilingual tag list, 4 bad-shot detectors (finger over the lens, blurry, ground, too dark) and, since v3, the camera cue "view ahead" (two-way softmax against "looking down at handlebars and the ground"). Exported locally: install with "Install from files" from E:\Memora Data\downloads\openclip-export-v3. IR vs PyTorch CPU: min cosine 0.9999980.

name: Whisper base (multilingual)
description: Speech transcription for Vietnamese and English (default speech model).
license: MIT (OpenAI Whisper weights; ggml conversion by ggerganov/whisper.cpp)
notes: Runs in whisper.cpp as a separate native process (ADR 0001). Load validation is added together with the whisper.cpp runtime.

name: Whisper small (multilingual)
description: Better transcription quality; optional, larger and slower than base.
license: MIT (OpenAI Whisper weights; ggml conversion by ggerganov/whisper.cpp)

name: Silero VAD (speech detection)
description: Skips wind, engine and other non-speech audio before transcription; prevents invented text.
license: MIT (Silero VAD; ggml conversion by ggml-org/whisper-vad)
notes: Used automatically by transcription when installed (whisper.cpp --vad). Measured on owner footage: removes noise hallucination loops, small model 53 s -> 33 s for 5 min.
